description: Defines the CookieAccessDelegate class interface for cookie access control, including methods for trustworthiness, access semantics, same-site restrictions, and first-party set metadata.

classes.name: net::CookieAccessDelegate
classes.description: Interface class for managing cookie access policies, including trustworthiness, semantics, same-site restrictions, and first-party set metadata computations.

methods.name: ShouldTreatUrlAsTrustworthy
methods.description: Determines if a URL should be considered trustworthy for cookie access.

methods.name: GetAccessSemantics
methods.description: Returns the access semantics for a given cookie.

methods.name: ShouldIgnoreSameSiteRestrictions
methods.description: Checks if SameSite restrictions should be ignored for a URL and site context.

methods.name: ComputeFirstPartySetMetadataMaybeAsync
methods.description: Computes first-party set metadata for a site, possibly asynchronously.

methods.name: FindFirstPartySetEntries
methods.description: Finds entries of sites in non-trivial first-party sets, possibly asynchronously.
